mapper.insert: INSERT INTO access_raw_event ( source, record_id, swing_task_id, swing_time, card_number, channel_code, channel_name, person_code, person_name, department_id, department_name, mapping_user_id, dahua_enter_or_exit, open_result, raw_json ) VALUES ( #{source}, #{recordId}, #{swingTaskId}, #{swingTime}, #{cardNumber}, #{channelCode}, #{channelName}, #{personCode}, #{personName}, #{departmentId}, #{departmentName}, #{mappingUserId}, #{dahuaEnterOrExit}, #{openResult}, #{rawJson} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE swing_time = VALUES(swing_time), card_number = VALUES(card_number), channel_code = VALUES(channel_code), channel_name = VALUES(channel_name), person_code = VALUES(person_code), person_name = VALUES(person_name), department_id = IF(VALUES(department_id) IS NOT NULL AND VALUES(department_id) != '', VALUES(department_id), department_id), department_name = IF(VALUES(department_name) IS NOT NULL AND VALUES(department_name) != '', VALUES(department_name), department_name), mapping_user_id = VALUES(mapping_user_id), dahua_enter_or_exit = VALUES(dahua_enter_or_exit), open_result = VALUES(open_result), raw_json = VALUES(raw_json)
mapper.select: SELECT id, source, record_id AS recordId, swing_task_id AS swingTaskId, swing_time AS swingTime, card_number AS cardNumber, channel_code AS channelCode, channel_name AS channelName, person_code AS personCode, person_name AS personName, department_id AS departmentId, department_name AS departmentName, mapping_user_id AS mappingUserId, dahua_enter_or_exit AS dahuaEnterOrExit, open_result AS openResult, raw_json AS rawJson FROM access_raw_event WHERE swing_time >= #{start} AND swing_time < #{end} AND mapping_user_id IS NOT NULL AND mapping_user_id != '' AND (open_result IS NULL OR open_result = 1) ORDER BY mapping_user_id, swing_time LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM access_raw_event WHERE swing_time >= #{start} AND swing_time < #{end} AND mapping_user_id IS NOT NULL AND mapping_user_id != '' AND (open_result IS NULL OR open_result = 1)
